about: souldew Renaissance's own additions to shared/data/catalog.json (merged by server/lib/library.mjs catalog(); a hack with the same id as upstream's replaces it). Kept in a file of its own so upstream's catalog merges without conflicts. Titles and metadata only – no links to ROM hacks or their download pages. ctrFingerprints: shared/ctr.mjs ncchFingerprint of the already-built game (.3ds / .cxi / .cia of it give the same).

hacks.name: Pokémon Rising Ruby
hacks.author: Drayano
hacks.descriptionEn: Drayano's enhancement hack of Omega Ruby in the style of Blaze Black 2 and Renegade Platinum: tougher trainers, a much wider choice of Pokémon and rebalanced Pokémon.
hacks.descriptionDe: Drayanos Erweiterungs-Hack von Omega Rubin im Stil von Blaze Black 2 und Renegade Platinum: stärkere Trainer, eine viel größere Pokémon-Auswahl und überarbeitete Pokémon.
hacks.uprNote: Not tested with UPR ZX – the run is played without the randomizer.
hacks.notes: Recognised as an already-built game (decrypted .3ds of v2.1, title ID of Omega Ruby 000400000011C400) by its contents fingerprint. Built on version 1.0 of Omega Ruby – souldew never installs the game's update for it.
